description:
Facts for the labelled-data chapter in one file. Read-only, no inference, no paid calls.

bootstrap_vs_pplx_b0: paired bootstrap of every labelled-data method against PPLX v1.2 B0 Run 1
(runs/prompt12_run01_20261019), method of inputs_b0_eval.py: stratified per benchmark, 10,000 replicates, seed 0,
same resample for all arms, mean F1 difference over the 8 benchmarks, 95% CI; differences and CIs in F1 points.
Mean arms (Ditto seed mean, Claude Code 3-run mean) take the mean F1 of the runs per replicate. Point F1 values are
checked against lr/results.json, ditto/results.json, claudecode_v3*/scores.json, claudecode_v3_reps_20261029.json,
labeled_rules_20261028.json and labeled_fewshot_20261028.json.
vs_pplx_b0: the same numbers in table form (method -> size -> diff, ci95). lr_gold_control: lr/gold_control.json.
label_sets: frozen sets and splits, how the pairs were chosen, Sol-B0 labels vs the official training labels on the
overlapping pairs, Sol cost. method_facts, inference_cost_test, leakage: see the keys.

    /path/to/envs/ditto-modern/bin/python src/labeled_chapter_facts.py         --astra-timing ~/promptval_scratch/astra_timing_20261030.json --out artifacts/results/labeled_chapter_facts_20261030.json
units: F1 as fraction; diff and ci95 in F1 points

lr_gold_control.description:
LR gold control: the labelled-chapter LR pipeline trained on the official benchmark training set. Read-only, free.

Same records, embeddings, features, LogisticRegression settings, C grid and threshold grid as labeled_chapter_20261028.lr,
and the same protocol as the Sol-set LR: the official training pairs (loader of labelsets_sol_eval_20261028.py) minus
pairs that are official validation or test pairs are split 80/20 within each class by labeled_chapter_20261028.split
(sha256 rank); train on the 80 %, C and threshold = maximum F1 on the 20 %, applied to test. Oracle variant: the same
model with the grid threshold that maximizes test F1. Side note (official_validation_variant): C and threshold tuned on
the official validation set (data/<b>/valid.json) instead, only where every validation pair has embeddings (WDC,
Billiger, Semi-HETER and Dn7 validation records have none or only part). No new embeddings, no API calls.
Writes lr/gold_control.json (write-once). Run with /path/to/envs/ditto-modern/bin/python.

selection.200: Similarity-search seed of the labelling paper source run (per-query seed rule, 30/70 positive/negative target), cleaned of official test and validation pairs, topped up to 100 pairs with the same seed rule, plus one AL-ML round of 100 pairs (committee LR, RF, ET, HistGBDT, XGBoost and rule scorers; 20,000 pool candidates; top-5 committee variance). Labels: GPT-6.1 Sol with the B0 request.
selection.2000: Nested in the 4000 set: the first k positives and 2000-k negatives of the 4000 set in labelling order, k at the 4000 set positive share (profile mechanism of the labelling repo); the seed is inside.
selection.4000: Nested-profile selection on the source AL run label list in labelling order (existing AL runs of the labelling paper), seed first, positives at the share of the benchmark small profile (dn7: medium, semi-heter: large). Semi-HETER: its 1,880 labelled pairs continued with AL-ML rounds of 500 on the same pool to 4,000. Pairs are relabelled by Sol (the GPT-5.2 labels only pick the pairs).
selection.cleaning: Every official test and validation pair is removed from seed, label lists and pool before selection.
selection.split: Stratified 80/20 train/validation per set; within each class pairs ranked by sha256('labeled-chapter-split|<benchmark>|<pair_id>'), first round(0.2 n) to validation.

sol_cost.note: One Sol call per unique pair (cache); the sets share pairs (2000 in 4000, the seed and part of the AL round of the 200 set in the 4000 set), so per-size costs are the stand-alone cost of 8 x size labels at the mean call cost; ledger_usd is what was spent. labelsets-sol-382880 is the Listing-1 pilot, whose labels are not used.

lr.feature_definition: Labelling paper AL-ML committee features (active_learning_ml._build_feature_matrix): per configured field one value: numeric closeness 1-|a-b|/max(|a|,|b|) if both values parse as numbers, else 1 for case-insensitive exact text match, 0 if both empty, else token Jaccard; plus the cosine of the text-embedding-3-small record embeddings (256 d; WDC 1536 d).
lr.tuning: C in [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100] x threshold in 0.05..0.95 (step 0.05), maximum validation F1 on the frozen validation split, first best kept; train on the train split only.

ditto.selection: Per epoch the threshold in [0, 1] (step 0.01) with the highest validation F1 (ditto_modern.metrics.tune_threshold_for_f1); the epoch with the highest tuned validation F1 is kept, its threshold is applied to test. Train/validation = frozen splits.

claudecode.isolation: bwrap jail, only the workspace (and state dir) bound; no web tools; no OpenAI; no PyDI; CPU; Python with numpy, pandas, scikit-learn
claudecode.workspace_note: input/train.json and input/valid.json: labelled pairs of the frozen split; no test pairs. Run directories are neutral ids rNN; TASK.md names only "dataset rNN".
applier_guards: parent process holds the test pairs; a fresh child (python -I -B) per random order loads only the matcher from a frozen copy of output/ and gets one pair at a time
file-open audit hook: only output/ and the Python installation may be opened
subprocess, exec, fork, spawn and socket events refused; ctypes events reported
predictions in two random orders must agree (order_invariant)

astra_rules.harness: Codex CLI exec, workspace-write sandbox, web search disabled, local Mac, ChatGPT login (no API keys)
astra_rules.prompt: B0 instruction + "General rules derived from a separate labeled training sample:" + one "- rule" line per rule

fewshot.retrieval: From the train split of the 4000 set (3,200 pairs) per test pair: BM25 over the serialized pair (B0 serialization, tokens [a-z0-9]+) and embedding cosine (mean of left-left and right-right record cosines, text-embedding-3-small), fused by RRF (k=60); at least k/5 examples per class; ordered by fused rank.
fewshot.placement: Examples go into the instruction text after B0 ("Labeled example pairs from a separate training sample ...", each "Example i (match|no match):" + the pair in B0 serialization): Jev noul instructions (Decisions API, no examples field) and the PPLX system message. Test-pair serialization and answer schema as B0.

inference_cost_test.note: usd_journals = attempts kept in the test journals (sums over 8 benchmarks); the ledger also holds the archived failed attempts. B0: Jev runs/quality (13 Oct), PPLX prompt12_run01_20261019.

notes.fewshot_shared_record: Share of test pairs for which at least one retrieved example has the same left or the same right record id (any example / an example labelled match). The example pair itself is never a test pair (official test and validation pairs were removed before selection).
notes.test_pair_duplicates_in_splits: Labelled pairs (train + validation of the frozen split) whose two records are content-identical to a test pair (duplicate records with other ids in the source tables); Aaron 28 Oct: not filtered. Same counts for every method (shared splits).
notes.claudecode_notes_naming_benchmark: NOTES.md matching grep -i -E "abt|buy\.com|walmart|amazon|dblp|acm|scholar|wdc|billiger|semi-heter|dn7" (as counted on 29 Oct); matchers contain only generic tokens.
